description: Pig dice — roll or hold, bust on 1, first to 100 wins. Play against a smart computer opponent.

faqs.a: Roll to add to your turn total, or Hold to bank it. Rolling a 1 busts — you lose the turn total.
The computer rolls until its turn total reaches 20, then holds — a classic Pig strategy.
First to 100 total points wins the game.
Your banked total is always safe — only the current turn total is at risk on each roll.

howto: Press Roll to build your turn total.
Hold to bank the points — or risk rolling on.
Rolling a 1 busts: turn total lost!
First to 100 wins. Beat the computer!
title: Pig Dice Game
